stem.text: An isolated neutron decays to produce a proton, a $\beta^{-}$ particle and an antineutrino.
Which row gives the quark composition of the neutron and the proton and the type of force that gives rise to this reaction?

A.text: down, down, up; down, up, up; strong interaction

B.text: down, down, up; down, up, up; weak interaction

C.text: down, up, up; down, down, up; strong interaction

D.text: down, up, up; down, down, up; weak interaction
